'''December 2001 Mainz tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Mainz, Germany on 9 December 2001. [[Achim Guenzel]] won it. It is known from Vjeko Keskic's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3231">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-01-04-09-12-2001-mainz-germanyd3231/ 09-12-2001-mainz-germany], DeckTech (Vjeko "mighty_maul" Keskic, 4 January 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-01-04-09-12-2001-mainz-germanyd3231/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 9 December 2001
* '''Site:''' Mainz, Germany
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Players:''' 18
* '''Winner:''' [[Achim Guenzel]]
